scope: Separately preregistered 1024-sample confirmation of unchanged engine revisions; retains original failed 64-sample study
compiler: Rust 1.99.0, opt-level 3 test profile, debug 0, default features, jobs 2
stale_changes: Replace IDs 0..16, delete IDs 16..24, insert IDs 8192..8200; writer replaces already-uncovered ID 0 once per query
writer_protocol: Preconstruct replacement; query signals writer at canonical scoring entry without waiting; measure acquisition wait and complete insert; immutable pre-query full-scan oracle checked after every sample
memory: Query-thread allocator calls and peak net requested bytes while rank_vector_snapshot runs; excludes corpus, writer allocations, output serialization, and allocator metadata/RSS

acceptance.correctness: Every complete ordered (document ID, chunk index, canonical score bits) list equals a coherent brute-force oracle; deterministic paused-scoring writer test and delta/bitmap boundaries pass
acceptance.writer: Median per-process writer lock-wait p50 decreases at least 50% at dimensions 128 and 768
acceptance.query: Median per-process query p50 and p99 increase no more than 15% for fresh_idle and stale_idle at each dimension; concurrent query latency reported without hiding tradeoffs
acceptance.allocation: Additional stale capture remains bounded by 512 KiB bitmap plus 128 document Arcs and at most 1024 scored delta hits; no embedding or document-text copy
acceptance.limits: Local synthetic fixed workload on a shared desktop, conditional on all host checks; no production/general-hardware claim. Preserve original failed study. No tuning, automatic reruns or selective exclusions.

source_pinning: Both engine commits are fixed to the original comparison before rebuilding; no production source changes or diagnostic measurements in this confirmation.

query_schedule.writer_versions: Original index+2 progression continues through 1032 iterations; query vectors alone repeat the original 64 recorded vectors.

original_study.query_gate: failed: fresh 16D median-process empirical p99 +24.6216%; never superseded or erased

confirmation_reason: Increase empirical tail-sample precision: original 64-sample nearest-rank p99 is the maximum; 1024 samples place p99 at the eleventh-largest sample. Original failed gate and background-activity observations remain retained. This is a separately preregistered study, not an original-plan retry.
binary_change: Existing binaries hardcode 8+64 iterations. Rebuild unchanged engine revisions with the same scoring instrumentation and only harness sample-count/query-schedule changes; preserve both original and new binary hashes.

host_conditions.exclusions: Only this harness PID, its descendants (including the active probe and ps collector), and its exact ancestor PIDs; never unrelated children of ancestors.
host_conditions.inconclusive_if: Any observed aggregate external CPU capacity >20%, any non-excluded build executable, failed process observation, changed logical CPU count, missing/failed process, expired execution budget, or missing quiet grant. Preflight violation prevents measurement; in-run violation stops after the active process and retains partial evidence. No exclusions or automatic retries.
host_conditions.limitation: This is an observed shared-host activity budget, not an isolated or idle host. Sampled ps CPU/load observations cannot rule out activity between observations or attribute latency changes; unrelated jobs are never stopped.
host_conditions.aggregate_definition: Sum all non-excluded ps CPU percentages divided by logical CPU count; ps 100% is one logical core. Exactly 20% total external capacity is allowed; >20% is inconclusive.
host_conditions.worker_condition: Coordinator confirms no WARM worker builds or tests during measurement; observed external compiler/build executables also disqualify the run.
